description: UCATSC: SUMO Dataset and Code for Uncertainty-Aware Constrained Traffic Signal Control Under Vision-Based Partial Observability is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jayawant Bodagala, Balaji Bodagala. This record contains the reproducibility package for the UCATSC study on uncertainty-aware constrained traffic signal control under vision-based partial observability. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
